What We Source

We don't hold a warehouse of stock — we buy to order from verified suppliers in China, so the part you get matches your part number exactly.

Chinese Heavy Trucks

Engine, gearbox, clutch and chassis parts for Sinotruk HOWO, Shacman, FAW, Foton and Dongfeng trucks — the backbone of Ethiopian freight.

Diesel Engines & Internals

Weichai and other Chinese diesel engines: pistons, liners, turbochargers, injection systems, gaskets and full overhaul kits.

Toyota Land Cruiser & Hilux

Genuine and OEM-equivalent parts for the Land Cruiser 70 series and Hilux — the vehicles NGOs, farms and tour companies depend on.

Heavy Equipment

Hydraulic pumps, filters, undercarriage and engine parts for excavators, loaders and other construction machinery working in Ethiopia.

Consolidated Freight

Small orders don't need a full container. We consolidate your parts with other shipments through Djibouti, so freight stays affordable.

Not Sure of the Part Number?

Send us a clear photo of the part plus your VIN or chassis number. We'll identify the exact part and quote it — free, with no obligation.

How It Works

Four steps from part number to your door in Addis Ababa — you see the parts before any money moves.

1

Send the Part Number

Send the OEM part number, a photo, or your VIN by the quote form or WhatsApp. Tell us the quantity you need.

2

We Source & Inspect

Our partner in Shanghai finds the genuine part and inspects it in person — photos and video to you before you commit.

3

One Landed Quote

One price covering the part, freight and delivery to Addis Ababa. No surprise add-ons later.

4

Shipped via Djibouti

Your order is consolidated with other shipments and sent through Djibouti to Addis Ababa.

Services

More than a parts shop — a sourcing partner on the ground in China, working only for Ethiopian buyers.

Genuine Parts Sourcing

We buy from authorized dealers and verified factories in China, matched to your OEM part number — genuine first, quality-branded alternatives only when you approve them.

In-Person Inspection

The difference. Our Shanghai partner physically checks every order — numbers, markings, seals, packaging — and sends you photos and video before anything ships.

Consolidation & Shipping

Orders from different suppliers are combined into one shipment via Djibouti to Addis Ababa — one freight bill, one point of contact, no container minimums.

Wholesale for Parts Shops

Already run a parts shop? We are your sourcing arm in China, not your competitor — you keep your customers, we handle finding, checking and shipping your stock.

Fleet & Equipment Support

Send us your fleet list and we build a wear-parts list with scheduled restocking — so the filters, belts and brake parts that stop trucks are already on your shelf.

Free Part Identification

No part number? Send a clear photo of the part and your VIN or chassis number. We identify the exact part and quote it — free, no obligation.

About 251 Parts

251 Parts is a new, family-run sourcing business connecting Ethiopian buyers directly to China's parts market. Our sourcing partner is on the ground in Shanghai and inspects every order in person; our team in Addis Ababa handles your quote, shipping and delivery.

We are starting small on purpose — no inflated claims and no catalogue we can't stand behind. Just genuine parts, verified one order at a time, until the trust is earned.

  • Family-run, on both ends of the route
  • Every order inspected in person in Shanghai
  • One landed price — no surprises after you order
